questions: Is the main problem an involuntary shaking or jerking of your right hand or arm?
Did it begin suddenly, over hours or a few days?
Did it begin after an injury, illness, major stress, or starting a new medication?
Is the movement present when your arm is completely relaxed and at rest?
Is it worse when you hold your arm out or use your hand?
Does it lessen or stop when you are distracted or concentrating on something else?
Can you stop the movement temporarily by willfully holding or relaxing your hand?
Does the movement change when you perform a rhythmic task with the other hand?
Does it disappear completely when you are asleep?
Have you had weakness of that arm or leg?
Have you had numbness or loss of sensation?
Have you had difficulty speaking, facial drooping, or trouble walking?
Have you noticed slowness, stiffness, or reduced dexterity on the same side?
Have you had similar involuntary movements elsewhere in your body?
Has anyone in your family had tremor or another movement disorder?
Have you recently taken or changed any medicines, including psychiatric medicines, anti-nausea medicines, or stimulants?
Have you previously had episodes like this that resolved or changed substantially?
